title: BarrierSteer: LLM Safety via Learning Barrier Steering

summary.claim: BarrierSteer uses non-linear safety classifiers on hidden states as control barrier functions, pushing latent trajectories away from unsafe regions during generation and lowering attack success without changing weights.
summary.condition: Inference time; multiple safety constraints combined by constraint merging; several model families and datasets.
summary.gap: (Authors) The guarantees hold only if the learned barriers capture the intended safety property.
